description: React component for vault dialog handling in Notesnook app, including vault management, password handling, biometric authentication, and note operations.

classes.name: VaultDialog
classes.description: React functional component managing vault operations, including password, biometric authentication, and note actions.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the vault dialog with provided data, handling biometric availability and credentials.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the vault dialog and resets state.

methods.name: deleteVault
methods.description: Deletes the vault and associated notes after password verification.

methods.name: clearVault
methods.description: Clears all notes from the vault after password verification.

methods.name: lockNote
methods.description: Locks a note in the vault.

methods.name: permanantUnlock
methods.description: Performs a permanent unlock of a note.

methods.name: openInEditor
methods.description: Opens a note in the editor.

methods.name: shareNote
methods.description: Shares note content via share dialog.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from vault and database.

methods.name: openNote
methods.description: Unlocks and opens a note, with options for editing, sharing, or deleting.

methods.name: unlockNote
methods.description: Unlocks a note with password or biometric.

methods.name: createVault
methods.description: Creates a new vault with password and optional biometric setup.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Main handler for dialog action button, managing vault, password, and note operations.
